_source: Built mechanically from the facts of CBP ruling N362347 (2026-06-26, held-out Part 102 window final; subject: "The tariff classification and country of origin of multilayered wood flooring"). Frozen by the D570 rule before any run. CBP held Canada. Components: the D362 materials; part codes: the top D381 held-out suggestion (unverified, D382); the good's code: CBP's (4412.52.3105). Family and name: the family check (wood_panels_flooring, 0.98); name from the subject (D381 rule). Materials with no country left out (1: clear, UV-cured coating). Groups: one model call with the production extractor's group rule (groups-f20.jsonl, D630). Plants one per country; operations one per group and plant plus final assembly in Canada. Target Paraguay by the D171 rule counted mechanically; plant capabilities for Paraguay are an assumption. Economics illustrative. D570 set, second pass D630.
